title: Relate pitch to frequency

hook.scenario: Chhote bacchon ki aawaz bahut patli (shrill) hoti hai, jabki ek adult aadmi ki aawaz bhaari (deep) hoti hai.
hook.question: Aawaz ke is 'patle' aur 'bhaari' pan ko physics mein kya kehte hain aur yeh kis par depend karta hai?

mental_model.intuition: Zyaada frequency = patli aawaz (high pitch), Kam frequency = bhaari aawaz (low pitch).
mental_model.description: Jab hamari vocal cords tezi se vibrate karti hain (high frequency), toh aawaz shrill ya high-pitched hoti hai. Agar vibrations slow hain (low frequency), toh aawaz deep ya low-pitched hoti hai.

explanation:
Hum jo sound sunte hain, uski ek property hoti hai **Pitch**. Pitch ka matlab hai ki ek sound dusre ke comparison mein kitni shrill (patli) ya flat (bhaari) lagti hai. Ye humare brain ka tarika hai sound ki frequency ko interpret karne ka.

Physics mein pitch seedhe tor par sound ki **frequency** par depend karti hai. Agar source of sound tezi se vibrate kar raha hai (yaani ek second mein zyada vibrations), toh uski frequency zyada hoti hai aur hum kahenge ki uski pitch high hai. Jaise ek flute (bansuri) ya kisi chidiya ki aawaz ki pitch high hoti hai.

Doosri taraf, agar source dheere vibrate kar raha hai, toh frequency kam hoti hai aur uski pitch bhi low hoti hai. Jaise ek dhak (drum) bajne par ya lion ki roar ki pitch low hoti hai.

Yaad rakhein, loudness aur pitch dono alag concepts hain. Ek patli aawaz dheemi (soft) ya tez (loud) dono ho sakti hai. Pitch sirf sound ke frequency nature ko define karti hai.

key_points.title: High Pitch
key_points.detail: Corresponds to a higher frequency of sound (faster vibrations).

key_points.title: Low Pitch
key_points.detail: Corresponds to a lower frequency of sound (slower vibrations).

worked_example.problem: Sound A has a frequency of 500 Hz and Sound B has a frequency of 1500 Hz. Which sound has a higher pitch?

steps.narration: Pitch seedhe frequency ke directly proportional hoti hai.
Kyunki Sound B ki frequency zyada hai, uski pitch bhi higher hogi.

worked_example.answer: Sound B has a higher pitch.

prediction.question: Pitch badhne par frequency (oscillations per second) mein kya farq padta hai?
choices: Vibrations tezi se aage-peeche hote hain (fast)
Vibrations ka size bada ho jata hai
prediction.explains: High pitch ka matlab high frequency. Particles ki aage-peeche jhulne ki speed (vibrations per second) badh jati hai, isliye ek second me zyada waves banti hain.

reflection.prompt: Jab pitch badhti hai, toh kya sound wave aage bhi zyada speed se bhaagti hai?
reflection.answer: Nahi, speed medium par depend karti hai, frequency par nahi. Aawaz utni hi speed me chalegi par usme waves zyada (paas-paas) hongi.

diagram3d.caption: High pitch (patli aawaz) = fast vibrations = high frequency.

worked_example.problem: A singer is singing a note. She then tightens her vocal cords to vibrate them faster. What happens to the pitch of the note?

steps.narration: Vocal cords tezi se vibrate kar rahi hain, jiska matlab hai ki frequency badh gayi hai.
Frequency badhne par pitch bhi badh jati hai aur aawaz aur patli ho jati hai.

worked_example.answer: The pitch of the note increases.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing pitch with loudness
common_mistakes.explanation: Pitch puri tarah frequency par depend karti hai, jabki loudness amplitude par depend karti hai.

recall_questions.q: What characteristic of a sound wave determines its pitch?
recall_questions.answer: Frequency determines the pitch of a sound.

recall_questions.q: Does a roaring lion produce a high-pitch or low-pitch sound?
recall_questions.answer: A roaring lion produces a low-pitch (low frequency) sound.

recall_questions.q: Which sound has a higher frequency: a drum or a whistle?
recall_questions.answer: A whistle has a higher frequency.

oa_questions.question: Which characteristic of the sound helps you to identify your friend by his voice while sitting with others in a dark room?
oa_questions.answer: The pitch and quality (timbre) of the sound.
oa_questions.approach: Mention the primary characteristics that make a voice unique: pitch (frequency) and timbre (waveform).

oa_questions.question: How does frequency affect the pitch of sound?
oa_questions.answer: The higher the frequency of a sound, the higher its pitch.
oa_questions.approach: Directly state the direct proportionality between pitch and frequency.
